header.fact: {count, plural, one {# asked, not done} other {# asked, not done}}

stage.title: Find what you asked for that never landed
stage.body: Atlas reads the messages you typed to Claude Code in this repository, picks out the requests, and checks each one against the commits on {branch}. A request at least 2 days old with no matching commit is listed here.
stage.local: Your messages go only to {model} at {address} on this computer. Nothing is sent anywhere else, and nothing is written into your repository or your agent's memory.
stage.scope: Reads {count, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}} from the last 14 days in {worktrees, plural, one {# folder} other {# folders}} of this repository.
stage.nightlyNote: Runs at most once a day, after 1:00, while Atlas is open, this computer is on power and no one has used it for 10 minutes. It stops when you touch the keyboard or mouse.

model.noneTitle: Needs a model on this computer
model.noneBody: Picking requests out of your messages needs a language model running on this computer, such as one in Ollama or LM Studio. Add its address in Agents › Models, then come back.
model.searchBody: Finding the commits closest to each request uses the model that search by meaning prepares on this computer. Set it up once in the Library, then come back.
model.notLocal: {address} is not on this computer. Only a model at localhost, 127.0.0.1 or ::1 may read your messages.

run.paused: Paused while you use this computer. It goes on the next time the computer is idle on power.
run.waiting: Waiting for this computer to be idle on power
run.stopped: Stopped. Requests checked so far stay in the list.
run.last: Last checked {time} · {count, plural, one {# new message} other {# new messages}}

list.title: Asked, not done
list.young: {count, plural, one {# request is under 2 days old and is checked later.} other {# requests are under 2 days old and are checked later.}}
list.emptyTitle: Nothing you asked for is missing
list.emptyBody: Every request from {from} to {to} has a matching commit on {branch}, or you marked it.

detail.closestBranch: Matching commit on {branch}, not merged into {base}
detail.noneMatch: None of these does what you asked.

error.model: {model} at {address} did not answer, so the check stopped at message {done} of {total}. Requests found so far stay in the list. Start the model, then press Check now to go on.
error.reply: {count, plural, one {# message got an answer Atlas could not read and was left out.} other {# messages got an answer Atlas could not read and were left out.}}
error.git: Git could not read {repository}, so no request was checked. The requests found are kept and checked when Git answers.
error.unreadable: {count, plural, one {# session file could not be read and was skipped.} other {# session files could not be read and were skipped.}} {path}
error.noSessions: No Claude Code session for this repository was found in {paths}.

web.title: Asked, not done runs in the app
web.body: It reads Claude Code's session files and runs a model on this computer. A browser can open neither, so this page cannot check your requests.
